name: AC Water Leakage Repair
tagline: AC water leakage diagnosis and repair
headline: Stop the Drip Where It Starts
summary: A dripping indoor unit is not a quirk of Chennai humidity. It is a blocked drain line, a coil icing over, a cracked drain tray, or a unit mounted at the wrong slope. We diagnose the actual cause and repair it from ₹599, backed by up to a 90-day service warranty.

symptoms.title: Water dripping indoors
symptoms.description: The indoor unit drips onto walls, furniture, or flooring whenever the AC runs for more than a few minutes.

symptoms.title: Damp patches on the wall
symptoms.description: Paint bubbles or a stain spreads below the unit, a sign condensate has been escaping the tray for weeks.

symptoms.title: Ice on the indoor coil
symptoms.description: Frost on the coil or copper pipes means the unit freezes while running, then leaks in bursts as the ice melts.

symptoms.title: Gurgling from the unit
symptoms.description: A bubbling or gurgling sound points to a partly blocked drain line trapping air and backing water up.

symptoms.title: Musty smell when cooling
symptoms.description: Stagnant water sitting in the drain tray turns musty fast in coastal humidity and often precedes a visible leak.

symptoms.title: Leak returns every summer
symptoms.description: Chennai drain lines clog with algae and sludge each season, so a leak that keeps coming back needs a proper flush, not a wipe-down.

faqs.question: Why is my AC leaking water inside the room?
faqs.answer: Four causes account for almost every indoor leak we see in Chennai: a drain line blocked with algae or sludge, a dirty coil icing over and melting in bursts, a cracked or overflowing drain tray, and an indoor unit installed at the wrong slope. Each has a different fix, which is why we diagnose before we quote. Guessing is how leaks come back.

faqs.question: Can I just keep a bucket under the unit for now?
faqs.answer: You can, but the water you catch is only part of the problem. Condensate also runs down inside the wall, ruining paint and inviting mould, which spreads quickly in Chennai's humidity. Water near the unit's electricals is also a risk not worth taking when the diagnosis and fix start at ₹599.

faqs.question: How long does a water leakage repair take?
faqs.answer: Most drain blockages, coil cleans, and tray repairs are completed in a single visit. If a replacement tray for your specific brand has to be arranged, we tell you before starting and return with the part. We offer same-day slots and a 60-90 minute reach in covered areas.

faqs.question: Does a leaking AC mean the gas is low?
faqs.answer: Sometimes. Low refrigerant makes the coil run too cold, ice over, and then leak as the ice melts, so we check gas pressure whenever we find frost on the coil. If a top-up is needed, it starts from ₹1,499 and you approve the cost before we proceed.

faqs.question: Will the leak come back next summer?
faqs.answer: Not if the cause is fixed properly, which is the point of our approach. Your repair carries up to a 90-day warranty, and a serviced drain line stays clear far longer than a poked-at one. If you want it handled before every season, our AMC plans start from ₹1,199 per unit per year and include preventive cleaning.
